import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths as given
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_94/training_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_94/training_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_94/training_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_94/training_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_94/training_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_94/training_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_94/training_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_94/training_7.csv"
    ]

    # Columns of the target schema (all source tables have the same schema)
    target_columns = [
        'movie_display_name',
        'movie_production_year',
        'movie_genre_display_name',
        'movie_financial_summary_production_budget',
        'movie_financial_summary_international_box_office',
        'movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold',
        'movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units',
        'movie_acting_role_display_name',
        'movie_theatrical_release_release_date',
        'movie_creative_type_display_name',
        'movie_production_method_display_name',
        'movie_source_display_name',
        'movie_running_time',
        'movie_technical_role_display_name',
        'movie_production_company_display_name',
        'movie_sequel'
    ]

    # Read all source CSV files into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target columns (all source schemas are identical)
        # If any column is missing or extra, this will raise an error or be handled here
        # But per prompt, all source schemas are identical to target schema columns
        # Just reorder columns to target_columns to be safe
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Data type conversions to match target schema:
        # movie_production_year: integer
        df['movie_production_year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_production_year'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

        # movie_financial_summary_production_budget: integer
        df['movie_financial_summary_production_budget'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_financial_summary_production_budget'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

        # movie_financial_summary_international_box_office: integer
        df['movie_financial_summary_international_box_office'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_financial_summary_international_box_office'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

        # movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold: float
        df['movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold'], errors='coerce')

        # movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units: float
        df['movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units'], errors='coerce')

        # movie_running_time: float
        df['movie_running_time'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_running_time'], errors='coerce')

        # movie_sequel: integer
        df['movie_sequel'] = pd.to_numeric(df['movie_sequel'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

        # movie_theatrical_release_release_date: string, ensure format YYYY-MM-DD or empty string if NaN
        df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'], errors='coerce').dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'] = df['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'].fillna('')

        # For string columns, fill NaN with empty string to avoid issues
        string_columns = [
            'movie_display_name',
            'movie_genre_display_name',
            'movie_acting_role_display_name',
            'movie_creative_type_display_name',
            'movie_production_method_display_name',
            'movie_source_display_name',
            'movie_technical_role_display_name',
            'movie_production_company_display_name'
        ]
        for col in string_columns:
            df[col] = df[col].fillna('')

        dfs.append(df)

    # Since all source tables have the same schema as the target, we UNION (concatenate) all rows
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Final type enforcement to match target schema exactly (redundant but safe)
    target_df = target_df[target_columns]

    # Write the result to the specified path
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_94/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
